title: A requirement whose SHALL sits at a line edge counts as a normative statement
description: A requirement whose SHALL sits at a line edge counts as a normative statement
no_spec_change_rationale: A requirement must contain a normative SHALL statement; a SHALL that a line break sets off, at the end or start of a wrapped line, is that statement, and validate_requirement refused it because it looked only for a space on each side (#1076)
acceptance_criteria: a requirement whose SHALL ends or starts a wrapped line is accepted; a requirement with no SHALL is still refused with the normative SHALL message
